name: GreetPlayer – Video Player, Video Bubble, Audio Player & Lead Capture
author: ThemeAtelier

sections.description:
GreetPlayer (formerly Greet Bubble) is an all-in-one video player, floating video bubble, audio player and playlist plugin for WordPress. Greet visitors with a personal video message, embed beautiful video and podcast players anywhere with a shortcode, and turn views into leads with call-to-action buttons — all managed from one unified Media screen.

Create a floating video bubble that welcomes visitors on any page, post, WooCommerce product or custom post type. Add a fully customizable video player with five skins, captions, chapters, branding and timed CTA overlays. Publish an audio-only (podcast) player in Compact, Card or Minimal layouts, or group your media into playlists with Sidebar and Grid layouts.

Play self-hosted files from your Media Library, YouTube, Vimeo or any external URL. Built-in analytics show views, plays, completion rates, watch time, unique viewers and trends for both your bubbles and your players — so you know exactly which videos work.

Lightweight, accessible and fully responsive: the bubble works with a keyboard and screen readers, can wait until the visitor scrolls, and can hold its video back until it’s needed. GreetPlayer is translation-ready and works with any theme, WooCommerce, multisite and RTL languages.

👁️View Live Demo | 🚀Upgrade to Pro | 📖Documentation | 👩🏼‍💻Get Support | 🌟Leave a Review

One Plugin for Video Bubbles, Video Players, Audio Players & Playlists

GreetPlayer replaces several single-purpose plugins. Use a floating video bubble to welcome visitors, a video player to showcase products and tutorials, an audio player for podcasts, and playlists for courses and series — with one consistent design and one analytics dashboard.

Key Features of GreetPlayer

Unified Media Management

  • One Media Screen: Create and manage floating bubbles, video players, audio players and playlists in one place, with search, type filters, list and grid views, bulk actions, duplicate and trash/restore.
  • Live Preview: See every change to your bubble or player instantly while you edit.
  • Copy-Ready Shortcodes: Every media item gets its own shortcode to place it on any page, post or widget area.
  • Import & Export: Move media between sites with CSV, XML and JSON import/export.
  • Multiple Video Sources: Play videos and audio from the Media Library, YouTube, Vimeo or any external URL.

Floating Video Bubble

  • Video Welcome Popup: Greet visitors with an introductory video in a floating bubble that expands into a full video popup.
  • Interactive Buttons: Add call-to-action buttons that play another video or open an internal page or external URL.
  • Multiple Videos per Bubble: Let visitors switch between videos with buttons, and reorder them with drag-and-drop.
  • YouTube, Vimeo & Subtitles: Use YouTube, Vimeo or external videos in the bubble, with subtitle support.
  • Video Preview: Play the closed bubble muted, show only its poster until the visitor hovers or taps, or start it when it comes into view. Visitors who prefer reduced motion or save data always see the poster first.
  • Per-Page Assignment: Besides the Site-wide Bubble, assign a bubble to chosen pages, posts, WooCommerce products, custom post types or categories with one Assign Bubble rule (unlimited rules in Pro).
  • Site-wide Visibility Rules: Show or hide the bubble on specific pages and posts.
  • Custom Video Poster & Intro Text: Set a poster image and the greeting text shown on the bubble.
  • Positioning Controls: Place the bubble bottom-left or bottom-right with precise px, em or % offsets.
  • Plays Well with Menus & Popups: Set the bubble’s stacking order to keep it under a sticky header, and hide it while a menu or popup is open.
  • Attention Effect, Time-Based Loading & Show After Scrolling: Draw the eye with an attention animation, and show the bubble after a delay, after the visitor scrolls a set distance (px or % of the page, optionally on mobile only), or whichever comes first.
  • Keyboard & Screen Reader Friendly: Visitors can reach the bubble with Tab, open it with Enter or Space and close it with Escape; every control has a name and a visible focus ring.
  • Pause on Tab Switch: Automatically pause the video when the visitor switches browser tabs.
  • Button Styling: Text-only or icon + text buttons, square or rounded shapes, border radius, colors, hover colors and tooltips.

Video Player

  • Five Player Skins: Pick a skin that matches your site, with two seek bar styles.
  • Playback Controls: Choose which player controls visitors see.
  • Subtitles & Chapters: Add subtitles and chapter markers for long-form videos.
  • SEO-Friendly: Players add VideoObject structured data, with an optional search engine description.
  • Branding: Add your logo to the player.
  • CTA Overlays & Action Bar: Show timed overlays and an action bar to drive clicks while the video plays.
  • Custom CSS: Fine-tune each player’s styling.

Audio Player & Playlists

  • Audio-Only (Podcast) Player: Compact, Card and Minimal layouts for podcasts, music and voice notes.
  • Playlists: Sidebar and Grid layouts with automatic play of the next item — perfect for courses, series and product tours.

Analytics

  • Bubble & Player Analytics: Track views, plays, completion rates, watch time and unique viewers.
  • Overview Dashboard & Trend Charts: Compare your bubbles and players side by side and spot trends over time.
  • Automatic Cleanup: Set a data retention period and clean up old analytics automatically or manually.

Design & Developer Friendly

  • Modern Admin: A fast, React-based admin with settings search (Ctrl/Cmd + K), light/dark mode and responsive layouts.
  • Customizable Colors: Predefined and custom colors for the bubble, buttons and player.
  • Custom CSS & JavaScript: Add your own code from the settings panel.
  • Settings Backup & Restore: Export and import your settings to reuse them across sites.
  • Responsive & Lightweight: Looks great and loads fast on desktop, tablet and mobile: the bubble uses a 2 KB icon font, posters and thumbnails load right-sized images, and playlists don’t shift the page as they load.
  • Multisite, Multilingual & RTL Ready: Works with WordPress multisite and translation plugins. On right-to-left sites the bubble and the player layout are mirrored and the player’s menus read right to left; the media controls (play, seek, volume) keep the usual left-to-right order.
  • Theme & Browser Compatibility: Works with all WordPress themes and all major browsers.
  • Documentation & Fast Support: Detailed documentation and a responsive support team.

GreetPlayer Pro Features

Upgrade to GreetPlayer Pro to unlock:

  • Lead Capture Forms: Open a contact form from a bubble button — Web3Forms, WhatsApp or any form plugin shortcode.
  • Premium Video Sources: Bunny.net, Gumlet, Mux and HLS streaming.
  • Extra Player Skins: Floating and Ambient skins, plus the Rapid Engage seek bar.
  • Advanced Analytics: Video watch funnel, top media, button performance, devices, top pages, browsers, countries and custom date ranges.
  • Device Targeting: Show the bubble only on desktop, tablet or mobile, with separate positions per device and your own mobile and tablet screen sizes.
  • More Positions & Effects: Middle-left/right positions, draggable bubble, icon-only buttons and six attention effects.
  • More Visibility Rules: Target theme pages, WooCommerce products, categories and tags.
  • Bubble Controls: Loop video, hide for session, and hide replay, mute and fullscreen buttons.
  • Typography: Full font control with 940+ Google Fonts.
  • Automatic Updates & Priority Support.

Use Cases

  • Greet new visitors with a personal video welcome bubble
  • Show product-specific video bubbles and players on WooCommerce product pages
  • Embed product demos, tutorials and testimonials with a branded video player
  • Publish podcasts and audio content with a lightweight audio player
  • Build course lessons, video series and product tours with playlists
  • Guide visitors with interactive video messages and call-to-action buttons
  • Measure which videos engage visitors with built-in analytics

sections.installation:
AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION (EASIEST WAY)

  • Visit Plugins > Add New
  • Search for GreetPlayer
  • Install and activate the GreetPlayer plugin

MANUAL INSTALLATION

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  • Download greet-bubble.zip
  • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  • Click on the “Upload Plugin” button
  • Choose the greet-bubble.zip file from your computer
  • Click “Install Now”
  • Activate the plugin after installation

Using FTP

  • Download greet-bubble.zip
  • Extract the greet-bubble folder on your computer
  • Upload the greet-bubble folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress

After Activation

  • Go to the “GreetPlayer” menu from the left sidebar in your WordPress dashboard
  • Open Media to create a video bubble, video player, audio player or playlist
  • Use Settings to assign bubbles to pages and adjust global options
sections.faq:
Is GreetPlayer the same plugin as Greet Bubble?

Yes. Greet Bubble has been renamed to GreetPlayer to reflect its new video player, audio player and playlist features. Your existing bubbles, settings, assignments and analytics carry over automatically when you update.

How do I add a floating video bubble to my website?

Go to GreetPlayer > Media, click Add New, choose Video Bubble, pick your video and customize it. Then assign it to specific pages from Settings > Assign Bubble, or show it site-wide.

How do I add a video player, audio player or playlist to a page?

Create the item from GreetPlayer > Media, then copy its shortcode and paste it into any page, post or widget area.

Which video sources are supported?

The free version plays videos and audio from your Media Library, YouTube, Vimeo and external URLs. GreetPlayer Pro adds Bunny.net, Gumlet, Mux and HLS streaming.

Can I show different video bubbles on different pages?

Yes. The free version has a Site-wide Bubble plus one Assign Bubble rule, which can cover many pages, posts or terms with the same bubble. GreetPlayer Pro has unlimited rules, so each page can have its own bubble.

Does GreetPlayer include analytics?

Yes. The free version tracks views, plays, completion rates, watch time, unique viewers and trends for bubbles and players. Pro adds the watch funnel, button performance, devices, pages, browsers, countries and custom date ranges.

Can I add a contact form inside the video bubble?

Yes, with GreetPlayer Pro. A bubble button can open a Web3Forms, WhatsApp or shortcode-based contact form to capture leads.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce products?

Yes, GreetPlayer works with WooCommerce and lets you show product-specific video bubbles and players on product pages.

Can I add buttons or links inside the video bubble?

Yes, you can add call-to-action buttons that play another video or link to internal pages and external URLs.

Are the players mobile-friendly?

Yes, the floating video bubble, video player, audio player and playlists are fully responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can customize colors, positions, animations, button styles, player skins, controls and more to match your website design.

Will GreetPlayer slow down my website?

No, GreetPlayer is lightweight and optimized for performance. The bubble loads a 2 KB icon font, posters and thumbnails load right-sized images, and with Video Preview set to Poster only or Play when visible the bubble’s video isn’t downloaded until it’s needed.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No, GreetPlayer is beginner-friendly with live previews and an easy settings panel. Developers can still add custom CSS and JavaScript.

Does GreetPlayer collect any data?

Only if you allow it. After activation, an administrator sees one notice on the Dashboard and the Plugins screen asking whether GreetPlayer may share usage data. Until you click Allow, GreetPlayer sends nothing, and No thanks sends nothing either. Your answer is remembered, also after deactivation, so you are asked once.

If you click Allow, GreetPlayer uses Appsero to send this once a week: your site name and URL, the first administrator’s name and the site’s admin email address, the WordPress, PHP, MySQL and server versions, the site language, the number of users and of active and inactive plugins, the GreetPlayer version, and the site’s public IP address (looked up through icanhazip.com when the data is sent). The deactivation feedback form is shown only after you have allowed this. See the Appsero privacy policy. To stop it, click Stop sharing usage data under GreetPlayer on the Plugins screen. Nothing is collected while GreetPlayer Pro is active.

Why does my bubble show its poster instead of playing?

A bubble’s Video Preview setting (Floating Bubble → Bubble) decides what the closed bubble does: Autoplay muted (the default) plays the video without sound as soon as the page loads, Poster only waits until the visitor hovers over, focuses or taps the bubble, and Play when visible waits until the bubble appears on screen. Visitors who have asked their device for reduced motion, or who have data saving (Save-Data) on, always see the poster first, in every mode, including the default; the video loads and plays when they open the bubble.
sections.changelog:
5.0.4 – 06 November 2026

  • Improved: Analytics no longer sends a request for every event. The bubble and the video player queue their events (views, plays, the 25/50/75% milestones, completion, clicks and watch time) and send them a few seconds after they happen, bundled with whatever else happened meanwhile, plus once more when the visitor leaves or hides the page. Pausing sends the watch time so far; seeking and progress ticks send nothing.
  • Improved: The tracking endpoint now does one database write per batch and nothing else: no reads of the analytics table, no option or meta writes. Each batch carries a site token, is size-limited and validated, and duplicate one-time events are dropped.
  • Improved: The Analytics page reads daily summary tables, instead of counting every raw event on each load. New events are folded in when the page loads, so a view shows up as soon as the visitor’s batch arrives, as before; reports are otherwise cached for 10 minutes and a background job keeps the summaries current every 15 minutes. On a site with 300,000 events, the “This Year” reports went from 1.2–2.8 s of database time per tab to about 0.15 s (0.03 s when cached).
  • Added: Settings → Advanced → Analytics → Exclude Editors: don’t track logged-in users who can edit posts. Off by default.
  • Added: Settings → Advanced → Analytics → Keep Raw Event Log For (default 90 days). Raw events are removed in small daily batches once they are in the daily summaries; your reports keep their full history. Auto Cleanup Analytics Data still controls how long report history is kept.
  • Added: Known bots, crawlers, uptime monitors and headless browsers are not tracked.
  • Added: Per-IP and per-session rate limits on the tracking endpoint on sites with a persistent object cache (Redis, Memcached) or APCu.
  • Changed: Database upgrade (analytics schema 2.0.0): two summary tables are added and five raw-table indexes only the old reports used are removed. Existing history is summarized in the background after the update, a month at a time; no data is lost. Pages cached with the previous tracking script keep working for 14 days.
  • Fixed: Opening a Video Bubble that is already playing its muted preview now counts as a play. Before, it only counted if the video was paused and started again, so Plays could stay flat while people watched.
  • Note: “Unique viewers” and “Visitors” are now summed per day and per video, so a visitor who watches two videos, or whose visit crosses midnight, counts once for each.

5.0.3 – 02 November 2026

  • Added: GreetPlayer block for the block editor. Choose a media item or playlist, or add new media and change its source without leaving the post; the editor shows the real player. Show it as the player on the page or as a button that opens it in a popup.

short_description: Video and audio player, floating video bubble and playlists with call-to-action buttons and built-in analytics.
description:
GreetPlayer (formerly Greet Bubble) is an all-in-one video player, floating video bubble, audio player and playlist plugin for WordPress. Greet visitors with a personal video message, embed beautiful video and podcast players anywhere with a shortcode, and turn views into leads with call-to-action buttons — all managed from one unified Media screen.

Create a floating video bubble that welcomes visitors on any page, post, WooCommerce product or custom post type. Add a fully customizable video player with five skins, captions, chapters, branding and timed CTA overlays. Publish an audio-only (podcast) player in Compact, Card or Minimal layouts, or group your media into playlists with Sidebar and Grid layouts.

Play self-hosted files from your Media Library, YouTube, Vimeo or any external URL. Built-in analytics show views, plays, completion rates, watch time, unique viewers and trends for both your bubbles and your players — so you know exactly which videos work.

Lightweight, accessible and fully responsive: the bubble works with a keyboard and screen readers, can wait until the visitor scrolls, and can hold its video back until it’s needed. GreetPlayer is translation-ready and works with any theme, WooCommerce, multisite and RTL languages.

👁️View Live Demo | 🚀Upgrade to Pro | 📖Documentation | 👩🏼‍💻Get Support | 🌟Leave a Review

One Plugin for Video Bubbles, Video Players, Audio Players & Playlists

GreetPlayer replaces several single-purpose plugins. Use a floating video bubble to welcome visitors, a video player to showcase products and tutorials, an audio player for podcasts, and playlists for courses and series — with one consistent design and one analytics dashboard.

Key Features of GreetPlayer

Unified Media Management

  • One Media Screen: Create and manage floating bubbles, video players, audio players and playlists in one place, with search, type filters, list and grid views, bulk actions, duplicate and trash/restore.
  • Live Preview: See every change to your bubble or player instantly while you edit.
  • Copy-Ready Shortcodes: Every media item gets its own shortcode to place it on any page, post or widget area.
  • Import & Export: Move media between sites with CSV, XML and JSON import/export.
  • Multiple Video Sources: Play videos and audio from the Media Library, YouTube, Vimeo or any external URL.

Floating Video Bubble

  • Video Welcome Popup: Greet visitors with an introductory video in a floating bubble that expands into a full video popup.
  • Interactive Buttons: Add call-to-action buttons that play another video or open an internal page or external URL.
  • Multiple Videos per Bubble: Let visitors switch between videos with buttons, and reorder them with drag-and-drop.
  • YouTube, Vimeo & Subtitles: Use YouTube, Vimeo or external videos in the bubble, with subtitle support.
  • Video Preview: Play the closed bubble muted, show only its poster until the visitor hovers or taps, or start it when it comes into view. Visitors who prefer reduced motion or save data always see the poster first.
  • Per-Page Assignment: Besides the Site-wide Bubble, assign a bubble to chosen pages, posts, WooCommerce products, custom post types or categories with one Assign Bubble rule (unlimited rules in Pro).
  • Site-wide Visibility Rules: Show or hide the bubble on specific pages and posts.
  • Custom Video Poster & Intro Text: Set a poster image and the greeting text shown on the bubble.
  • Positioning Controls: Place the bubble bottom-left or bottom-right with precise px, em or % offsets.
  • Plays Well with Menus & Popups: Set the bubble’s stacking order to keep it under a sticky header, and hide it while a menu or popup is open.
  • Attention Effect, Time-Based Loading & Show After Scrolling: Draw the eye with an attention animation, and show the bubble after a delay, after the visitor scrolls a set distance (px or % of the page, optionally on mobile only), or whichever comes first.
  • Keyboard & Screen Reader Friendly: Visitors can reach the bubble with Tab, open it with Enter or Space and close it with Escape; every control has a name and a visible focus ring.
  • Pause on Tab Switch: Automatically pause the video when the visitor switches browser tabs.
  • Button Styling: Text-only or icon + text buttons, square or rounded shapes, border radius, colors, hover colors and tooltips.

Video Player

  • Five Player Skins: Pick a skin that matches your site, with two seek bar styles.
  • Playback Controls: Choose which player controls visitors see.
  • Subtitles & Chapters: Add subtitles and chapter markers for long-form videos.
  • SEO-Friendly: Players add VideoObject structured data, with an optional search engine description.
  • Branding: Add your logo to the player.
  • CTA Overlays & Action Bar: Show timed overlays and an action bar to drive clicks while the video plays.
  • Custom CSS: Fine-tune each player’s styling.

Audio Player & Playlists

  • Audio-Only (Podcast) Player: Compact, Card and Minimal layouts for podcasts, music and voice notes.
  • Playlists: Sidebar and Grid layouts with automatic play of the next item — perfect for courses, series and product tours.

Analytics

  • Bubble & Player Analytics: Track views, plays, completion rates, watch time and unique viewers.
  • Overview Dashboard & Trend Charts: Compare your bubbles and players side by side and spot trends over time.
  • Automatic Cleanup: Set a data retention period and clean up old analytics automatically or manually.

Design & Developer Friendly

  • Modern Admin: A fast, React-based admin with settings search (Ctrl/Cmd + K), light/dark mode and responsive layouts.
  • Customizable Colors: Predefined and custom colors for the bubble, buttons and player.
  • Custom CSS & JavaScript: Add your own code from the settings panel.
  • Settings Backup & Restore: Export and import your settings to reuse them across sites.
  • Responsive & Lightweight: Looks great and loads fast on desktop, tablet and mobile: the bubble uses a 2 KB icon font, posters and thumbnails load right-sized images, and playlists don’t shift the page as they load.
  • Multisite, Multilingual & RTL Ready: Works with WordPress multisite and translation plugins. On right-to-left sites the bubble and the player layout are mirrored and the player’s menus read right to left; the media controls (play, seek, volume) keep the usual left-to-right order.
  • Theme & Browser Compatibility: Works with all WordPress themes and all major browsers.
  • Documentation & Fast Support: Detailed documentation and a responsive support team.

GreetPlayer Pro Features

Upgrade to GreetPlayer Pro to unlock:

  • Lead Capture Forms: Open a contact form from a bubble button — Web3Forms, WhatsApp or any form plugin shortcode.
  • Premium Video Sources: Bunny.net, Gumlet, Mux and HLS streaming.
  • Extra Player Skins: Floating and Ambient skins, plus the Rapid Engage seek bar.
  • Advanced Analytics: Video watch funnel, top media, button performance, devices, top pages, browsers, countries and custom date ranges.
  • Device Targeting: Show the bubble only on desktop, tablet or mobile, with separate positions per device and your own mobile and tablet screen sizes.
  • More Positions & Effects: Middle-left/right positions, draggable bubble, icon-only buttons and six attention effects.
  • More Visibility Rules: Target theme pages, WooCommerce products, categories and tags.
  • Bubble Controls: Loop video, hide for session, and hide replay, mute and fullscreen buttons.
  • Typography: Full font control with 940+ Google Fonts.
  • Automatic Updates & Priority Support.

Use Cases

  • Greet new visitors with a personal video welcome bubble
  • Show product-specific video bubbles and players on WooCommerce product pages
  • Embed product demos, tutorials and testimonials with a branded video player
  • Publish podcasts and audio content with a lightweight audio player
  • Build course lessons, video series and product tours with playlists
  • Guide visitors with interactive video messages and call-to-action buttons
  • Measure which videos engage visitors with built-in analytics

OTHER AMAZING PRODUCTS FROM ThemeAtelier

➡️ Darkify Dark Mode – A lightweight and customizable WordPress dark mode plugin for a sleek, accessible, and eye-friendly experience on both the frontend and admin dashboard.

➡️ ChatHelp – WhatsApp Chat Help Plugin – A flexible WhatsApp chat plugin that helps website visitors start instant conversations with you directly from your WordPress site.

➡️ Domain For Sale – A domain listing and offer management plugin that helps you list domains, collect buyer offers, and manage secure sales with escrow payments directly from WordPress.

➡️ Eventful for Elementor – Events Showcase For The Events Calendar and Elementor – An Elementor addon for The Events Calendar that lets you design and display events using Elementor widgets with advanced, responsive layouts.
